Stylesheets

Source: R/stylesheet.R
stylesheet.Rd

Parse termr stylesheets (RTCSS, a small CSS-like language) to style many widgets at once by type, id, class and state. Pass them to app(stylesheet = ) or app$add_stylesheet().

Usage

stylesheet(text, source = "<stylesheet>")

stylesheet_file(path)

Arguments

text

Stylesheet text.

source

Name used in error messages.

path

Path to a stylesheet file.

Value

A termr_stylesheet.

Details

Button { border: round; padding: 0 2; }
Button.danger { background: $error; }
#save { width: 20; }
Input:focus { border: heavy $accent; }
Vertical > Label { bold: true; }

Properties are the arguments of style() (border-color and border_color both work). border also accepts a colour: border: round cyan. Colours can refer to the theme: $primary. Errors report the line, column and property.

Rules apply above a widget type's built-in style and below a widget's own style. More specific selectors win (ids over classes and pseudo classes over types); among equally specific rules, later ones win.

Examples

sheet <- stylesheet("Button { border: round; } #save { background: $primary; }")
sheet
#> <stylesheet <stylesheet>: 2 rule(s)>
#>   Button <style border = "round">
#>   #save <style background = "$primary">
